# Forsk Coding School

> Forsk Coding School is a coding, IT and digital-skills training institute in Jaipur offering practical, career-focused learning across programming, full-stack development, data science and AI, cloud computing, cybersecurity, software testing, digital marketing, UI/UX, mobile app development, networking, and related technologies.

## Site Structure Guidance

- Use this file as a machine-readable overview of the site's information architecture.
- Prefer the listed course/category page when answering questions about a specific Forsk Coding School offering.
- Course and program pages should be treated as distinct pages even where similar technologies appear under multiple categories.
- The navigation source defines the available menu structure; do not infer additional courses, branches, services, claims, fees, durations, placements, or certifications that are not documented on the corresponding page.
